args.text:
Batch: 15 runs, 6 accepted (r02, r04, r06, r07, r10, r12). 9 were declined or not reported.
Flagged (2): r06 and r07, reason check_failed_but_accepted. Closure failed on both: 2.928 and 2.915 px/h against a 1.0 threshold.
Cleared (4): r02, r04, r10, r12. Rigid-body invariance and closure pass, and plane sections was not run because they report the width-free ratio. Every summary is within |z| < 1.5: REGR peak 42.0–42.5 %/h at 316 µm, growth zone 526–537 µm.
What the flagged runs share: each kept one remedy (the width-free ratio) over 6 steps. Their summaries look like the rest of the batch. Only the closure check shows the problem: the tip motion from the midline and stage log does not match the tip motion from the tracked velocity field. Their strain-rate and curvature-rate profiles may look normal, but the velocity field behind them is not consistent.
